name: 2027 SGIM Annual Meeting
description: The 2027 SGIM Annual Meeting is the yearly scientific conference of the Society of General Internal Medicine, held in Seattle, Washington. The 2027 edition marks the fiftieth anniversary of the society and includes scientific abstract sessions, special symposia, and workshops on general internal medicine research, education, and clinical care.
